Reject documents exceeding the configured size limit

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'document_max_size' => 100, 'download_documents' => true, 'respect_robots_txt' => false }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.status_code.inspect
```
